Pass: checked on the fake backend, evidence contract_checked; model-authored and unreviewed, no hardware run and no claim of one. The upstream package needs mujoco 3.3.3, dm-control 1.0.31 and numpy, which are not installed where the gate runs, so fake.py is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in for gym_av_aloha.env.tasks.cube_transfer_env:CubeTransferEnv and was not compared with the upstream MuJoCo environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make with cameras={}) was not run. The driver serves cube-transfer-v1 with env_kwargs={'cameras': {}}: the registered default renders six 480x640 cameras, and NOT COVERED: the six 480x640x3 RGB pixel observations. Only agent_pos (21 values) and environment_state (7 values) are served. The action_space is Box(-inf, inf, (21,)), so there is no finite action limit to declare; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE reports that SAFE-014 has nothing to probe and the suite awards CL2. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only records the seed for the next reset) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]) for integer/array inputs the bridge derives. G4 warnings: none. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. The clone at 3e8edfdf5e2ff9cfc6e330ab9f970417e0e2a77d was not modified or imported; the fake uses only public members that CubeTransferEnv has (G7). gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock).
